quests.offer: Logger Kripps, in the house on the road outside the city, has a problem. Help him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find Logger Kripps in his house on the road outside the city.
steps.says: The Red Eyed Monster, northwest of town across the river. Bring me its eye.

steps.journal: Kill the Red Eyed Monster northwest of town for its eye.
Bring the monster's eye to Logger Kripps.
steps.says: Tell Druza it's done.

steps.journal: Return to Foreman Druza.
steps.says: Well done.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/moradhim/rogue.json, Level 7; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The Red Eyed Monster is not in the database. quests.name: The Goblin Mines
quests.offer: Brenn Raven in Diren's Hold, west of Moradhim, on the second floor of the fort's tower, needs someone quick and quiet.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find Brenn Raven in Diren's Hold, second floor of the tower.
steps.says: The goblins set three mines along the river from the dam. Disable them and bring me their springs.

steps.journal: Disable the first mine, at the dam.

events.text: You work the spring free of the mine. A goblin comes at you!

steps.journal: Disable the second mine up the small river.

events.text: You work the spring free of the second mine. Another goblin attacks!

steps.journal: Disable the third mine.

events.text: The third mine is harmless now. One more goblin!

steps.journal: Bring the three springs to Brenn Raven.
steps.says: Now see Jarvan Tember atop the tall hill by the fort.

steps.journal: Find Jarvan Tember atop the tall hill by Diren's Hold.
steps.says: Three marauders in the dark tower east of the Hold keep a key. Get it and set Amber free.

steps.journal: Kill the marauders in the dark tower east of Diren's Hold for their key.
Set Amber, the little wolf, free.
Return to Jarvan Tember.
steps.says: Amber is free. Thank you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/moradhim/rogue.json, Level 10; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The mines' places are EQOA-Data's map's; the guide's 30 seconds at each is not in, and the goblin that attacks there is a Freezeblood brawler of the Hold's (the guide says a level 10 goblin). The Frosteye marauders and Amber, the little wolf they hold, are not in the database. It follows L5: L7 before it is a draft until its names are in the database.

quests.name: The Orb of Parathior
quests.offer: Elder Joram, in the bank of Halas, has a task worthy of you. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.

steps.journal: Find Elder Joram in the bank of Halas.

Bring the Orb of Parathior to Elder Joram.
steps.says: Belgar Karakson in Moradhim's residential district knows how to destroy it.

steps.journal: Find Belgar Karakson in the last house on the right of Moradhim's residential district.
steps.says: Bring me the two pages of Karak's research the orcs of the Druk keep.

steps.journal: Kill orc acolytes at the bottom of the caves in the Druk for the first page of Karak's research.
Kill orc prophets at the bottom of the caves in the Druk for the second page.
Return to Elder Joram with the pages.
steps.says: Now a goldfeather: kill a Goldfeather aviak by their aerie north of Moradhim's coach.

steps.journal: Kill a Goldfeather aviak by the Goldfeather aerie for a goldfeather.
Bring the goldfeather to Elder Joram.
steps.says: I will send you to the lava tubes of Mt. Hatespike. Crush the feather over the orb and drop it in.

steps.journal: Crush the goldfeather over the orb and drop the orb into the lava tubes.

events.text: You crush the goldfeather over the Orb of Parathior and drop it into the lava. It is gone.

steps.journal: Tell Elder Joram the orb is destroyed.
steps.says: Go back to Belgar Karakson with his pages.

steps.journal: Give Belgar Karakson the pages of Karak's research.
steps.says: You have earned this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data's guide (Quests/1-20/moradhim/rogue.json, Level 20; github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data). The Freezeblood Treasurer is not in the database (King Ickcil's chest is, as the Parathoir Chest). The lava tubes' place is EQOA-Data's map's: Elder Joram's gem sends you there and back. The guide's final choice of reward is not in: the quest gives its experience only.
